questions.q: What problem does an Account Group solve?
options: It replaces the need for the General Ledger entirely
It gives a user a quick, curated watchlist of specific accounts without building a full formatted statement
It schedules reports to run automatically every night
It secures payroll data from unauthorized users
questions.explain: An Account Group is a lighter-weight alternative to a formal statement when all a user needs is to monitor a handful of chosen accounts.

questions.q: What visualization does Oracle Fusion use to display an Account Group in the Financial Reporting Center?
options: A Gantt chart
Sunburst, a radial chart with nested rings sized by balance
A standard bar chart only
No visualization is provided
questions.explain: Account Groups are displayed using the Sunburst visualization, letting a user see at a glance which accounts carry the largest balances.

questions.q: Account Groups are scoped to which area of Oracle Fusion Financials?
options: Receivables transactions only
Payables invoices only
General Ledger accounts and balances only
Fixed Assets depreciation schedules only
questions.explain: Account Groups are built from General Ledger accounts and balances; other modules rely on different tools like OTBI for similar monitoring.

questions.q: If someone wants to casually monitor open Payables invoices rather than GL account balances, what should they use instead of an Account Group?
options: Nothing — this cannot be done in Oracle Fusion
An OTBI analysis
The Sunburst visualization applied to Payables
A Financial Reporting Studio statement is the only option
questions.explain: Account Groups are GL-only; monitoring something like open Payables invoices is better served by an OTBI analysis against the Payables subject area.

questions.q: What is the main trade-off of an Account Group compared to a full Financial Reporting Studio statement?
options: Account Groups take longer to build than a full statement
Account Groups are quick to set up but skip the formal row/column/formula design work a statement requires
Account Groups can only be viewed by administrators
There is no trade-off; they are functionally identical
questions.explain: The simplicity that makes Account Groups fast to create also means they lack the formal structure needed for a distributable financial statement.
